claim.en: Dubovský became publicly known for filing a criminal complaint against deputy speaker Ľuboš Blaha for replacing the president's portrait with one of Che Guevara; he then received anonymous threats.
claim.sk: Dubovský sa dostal do povedomia trestným oznámením na podpredsedu parlamentu Ľuboša Blahu za nahradenie portrétu prezidentky portrétom Che Guevaru; následne dostával anonymné vyhrážky.

findings.identity: profile of presidential candidate Patrik Dubovský, 59, historian, Dunajská Streda
findings.quote: Dubovský came to public attention when he filed a criminal complaint against Deputy Speaker of Parliament Ľuboš Blaha (Smer) for replacing the official portrait of the president with a portrait of Cuban communist revolutionary Che Guevara in his office. Subsequently, he received anonymous threats.

claim.en: Historian Dubovský has worked since 2004 at the Nation's Memory Institute (ÚPN), researching religious persecution and civic resistance under communism; earlier he worked at the Culture Ministry and the Government Office.
claim.sk: Historik Dubovský pracuje od roku 2004 v Ústave pamäti národa, kde skúma prenasledovanie cirkví a občiansku rezistenciu za komunizmu; predtým pôsobil na ministerstve kultúry a Úrade vlády.

findings.identity: profile of presidential candidate Patrik Dubovský, 59, historian, Dunajská Streda
findings.quote: Historian Patrik Dubovský, who studied at University College London, works at the Nation’s Memory Institute (ÚPN). He worked at the Culture Ministry, and also the Government Office. In 2004, he started working at the ÚPN, where he focuses on religious persecution and civic resistance during the communist regime in Czechoslovakia.
